recipes.name: Buffalo Chickpea Sandwich
instructions: In a medium bowl, use a fork to mash together all the chickpea salad ingredients.
In a small bowl, mix together all the ranch mayo ingredients.
Spread the ranch mayo over one side of each bread slice. Top with the lettuce, tomatoes, and chickpea salad, then close with the remaining slices. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † We used Frank's Red Hot Sauce.

Storage The prepared sandwich is best enjoyed on the day it's made. Note that the bread will get a bit soggy over time. The sandwich filling can be stored in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 days.
